result_text: Both tooltips now HTML-escape the repository name before it goes into the `title` attribute. The browser then shows the name as plain text, e.g. `acme "shop" (5,000 LOC)` in the language block and `acme "shop" 5000` in the size table. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or render a report with such a name, so the escaped output hasn't been checked. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **`addLangInfo`:** this covers the main, test and other code variants of the language blocks. - **Size distribution table:** the `info` string built in the "Repositories Size Distribution" section. - **Import:** I added `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils`, which other classes in the module already use. Only the name is escaped. Counts, LOC, order and layout are unchanged.
